MCAT RESOURCE HUB — HEADER LOGO
================================
Three small edits to your index.html. The image is embedded, so there's
nothing to upload and nothing that can 404.


── EDIT 1: add this CSS rule (put it with your other header CSS) ──────

  .site-logo { height: 52px; width: auto; flex-shrink: 0; }


── EDIT 2: add the logo <img> as the FIRST thing inside <header> ──────
Your header currently starts like this:

  <header>
    <div style="flex:1;">
      <h1>MCAT resource hub</h1>

Change it to (new line marked):

  <header>
    <img class="site-logo" alt="MCAT Resource Hub logo" src="data:image/png;base64,">
    <div style="flex:1;">
      <h1>MCAT resource hub</h1>


── EDIT 3 (optional, for mobile): inside your existing ────────────────
   @media (max-width: 640px) { ... } block, add:

  .site-logo { height: 40px; }


That's it. Hard-refresh the tab to see it.
